claim: The behaviour arbiter decides from the pressures appraisal measured AND the acting capacity the queue authority owns, and every pressure it publishes reaches something that acts on it. Capacity it was not told is UNKNOWN, never assumed free. The substrate can feel each pressure it is under, not only the situation that produced it.
hypothesis: If capacity were still assumed, an arbiter told nothing would admit self-directed exploration exactly as one told there are free slots does. If replan and persistence were still dangling, no combination of them would change whether a failed attempt is repeated.

checks.label: the state genuinely wants to explore (isolates the capacity gate)
told NOTHING about capacity, exploration is REFUSED
and it SAYS the capacity is unknown, rather than implying a limit it measured
told there is ROOM, the same state explores
told there are NO SLOTS, it does not
told the BACKLOG is hard, it does not — and names the backlog
UNKNOWN is not treated as FREE (the defect: both used to admit)
with no appraisal at all, unknown capacity is still reported
a caller that states nothing still gets a capacity-informed directive
an explicit argument still overrides the queue
an UNREADABLE queue yields capacity_unknown, not an assumed free slot
the state says the APPROACH is wrong
and it does NOT say to stay the course
a working line publishes should_persist (the field had no producer before)
replan + nothing changed  -> the repeat is refused
replan + a CHANGED method -> the retry proceeds on its own merit
persistence is a real counterweight: holding the approach right keeps the budget
a neutral directive never blocks a retry (no behaviour change where nothing is felt)
the directive publishes should_persist to anything that reads it
all seven pressures are readable as self-state
each maps to the appraisal field that actually holds it
the measured situation is still there beside the pull
a substrate that wants to learn can SAY it feels the pull to learn
every pull it reports is a real number it derived, not a placeholder

notes: The capacity gate is proven against the REAL queue authority and the coordinator's own disposition(); only the coordinator shell is stood in for, so the method under test is the one that runs.
repeat_is_thrash mirrors the predicate in _execute_and_validate_task. It is asserted here against real directives, not re-derived.
